citation: "Hersel Davis, Myrtle Mosley." Historical Document Record (1947). Preserved in the Nanticoke & Moor Historical Archive (Written in the Genome Collection).
lines: Delaware Certificate of Marriage, File No. 4339. Hersel Davis of Milton, age 34, born June 3, 1913, father Morris Davis, mother Hester Davis; Myrtle Mosley of Milton, age 34, born September 5, 1913, father Harry Mosley, mother Maggie Mosley. Married September 16, 1947, Milton, Sussex County, by Rev. G. S. Sterling.
full_text: Delaware Certificate of Marriage, File No. 4339.
